baseline_observations: index-START.html had an empty <script> block, so hovering over navigation items displayed no dropdown backgrounds or animations.
Without the follow-along pill calculation, the dropdownBackground remained stationary at opacity: 0.
Keyboard focus (focusin/focusout) was unhandled on nav items, leaving dropdown menus inaccessible to keyboard users.
decision: Implement the follow-along dropdown coordinate tracking and transition animation with keyboard focus support in index-START.html. Design the regression test suite to verify the correct behavior, deliberately simulate an interaction regression (such as missing mouseleave cleanup or disconnected coordinate tracking) in a test fixture, and assert that the regression suite reliably detects the regression.
